summary: Ratios User Entry formulas can round an operand with ROUND(x, digits), and the growth and cutoff adjustment macro uses it so the adjusted factor reconciles with the method notes.
details: ROUND rounds half up on the decimal digits, in the browser and on the server alike, so 2.38625 to four places is 2.3863.
Apply Growth and Cutoff Adjustments now writes = ROUND("Simple - 2", 4) * [Accounting Cutoff][-1] * ..., leaving the adjustment vectors unrounded.
Generate Notes for Combined Adjustment shows a rounded term at that precision, so the note's multiplication reproduces the User Entry value.
